districts.notes: Not verified. The district now has 5 divisions per the official revenue-divisions page: Puttaparthi, Penukonda, Kadiri, Dharmavaram and Madakasira. However, no current official division-wise mandal list was found. The official mandal page lists 32 tahsildars (its text still says '29 Mandals'), and these are used as the mandal list. The official village-panchayats page is a stale 2022 layout: 3 divisions, 29 mandals, no Dharmavaram division, and Ramagiri, Kanagapalli and Chennekothapalli missing. Madakasira division (Madakasira, Gudibanda, Rolla, Amarapuram, Agali) is confirmed by G.O.Ms.530 (title only; body not readable), ETV Bharat and The Hindu, which say these five came from Penukonda division. Penukonda division is derived from the official 2022 page's Penukonda list minus those five mandals. That matches The Hindu (27 Dec 2025), which says Gorantla goes into Penukonda division in the final layout. The Hindu also says Amadagur was moved from Kadiri to Puttaparthi division. The other memberships of Puttaparthi, Kadiri and Dharmavaram divisions could not be confirmed from an official source, so 19 mandals are left unassigned. Unofficial Wikipedia mapping, not used: Dharmavaram = Bathalapalle, Chennekothapalle, Dharmavaram, Kanaganapalle, Mudigubba, Ramagiri, Tadimarri; Kadiri = Gandlapenta, Kadiri, Nallacheruvu, Nambulapulakunta, Talupula, Tanakal; Puttaparthi = Amadagur, Bukkapatnam, Kothacheruvu, Nallamada, Obuladevaracheruvu, Puttaparthi. Mandal spellings follow the official tahsildar page. Common alternates: Somandepalle, Chilamathur, Kanaganapalle, Chennekothapalle, Obuladevaracheruvu. The district site lists all six ULBs under 'Municipalities'. Madakasira and Penukonda are recorded as nagar panchayats because the PMAY-U list and DTCP-2021 both say NP, and Penukonda's listed email is 'mdksnagarapanchayat'. Puttaparthi was an NP in DTCP-2021 but is a municipality per PMAY-U and the district site ('Puttaparthy Municipality').

It reflects the Dec 2025 changes: Rajampet division (Rajampet, Nandalur, Veeraballi, T. Sundupalli) moved from Annamayya to Kadapa, and Vontimitta and Sidhout stayed in Kadapa division. The Nov 2025 preliminary proposal to move them to Rajampet was dropped (NewsMeter, The Hindu). Spellings follow kadapa.ap.gov.in/revenue-mandals/. 'V.N. Palli' is written as 'Veerapunayunipalle', as on the site's second tahsildar page. 'SAKN' is kept as the site writes it; it is not expanded because the full name was not verified on an official page. Alternate official spellings include Khajipeta, Peddamudiam, Chapadu, Proddutur, T Sundupalli and Veeraballe. The site's revenue-division intro text still says '4 Revenue divisions' but its table lists 5. ULB types are uncertain for three towns. The district site lists Jammalamadugu, Kamalapuram and Yerraguntla as municipalities. The PMAY-U list and the 2021 DTCP list classify all three as nagar or town panchayats. Jammalamadugu's own listed address says 'Jammalamadugu Nagar Panchayat', and Kamalapuram's email is 'kamalapuram.np', so both are recorded as nagar-panchayat. Yerraguntla is kept as municipality per the district site, but PMAY-U and DTCP-2021 say NP, so its type should be re-checked against CDMA.
